newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent heads higher, eyes resistance at $18.30.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent heads higher, eyes resistance at $18.30.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures extended their gains by midsession, dragging gas oil futures higher with them.
August Brent was 39 cents higher at $18.25 a barrel by 1105 GMT. July gas oil was $2.00 higher at $163.75 a tonne.
Dealers said the upmove came as players covered their short positions and the market broke through technical resistance levels.
Beyond the break of $18.15, dealers cited resistance targets at $18.30 and then $18.50.
But dealers were unsure the rally would persist.
"I'm not convinced it's going to stay up here. With the OPEC meeting next week, I think some people are going to get out," one said.
OPEC ministers are due to meet in Vienna on June 25 to review their production quotas for the second half of the year.
Gas oil, meanwhile, was trending higher in Brent's slip stream. But dealers agreed it was rangebound with resistance at $164.50 and support at $161.50.
"You'd have to see a big move for crude to take it higher," one said.
